spec.situation_desc: had their savings interest rate cut without noticing any letter

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thistle Bank, Liam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi. I'm Imran Varga. I've just realised the interest rate on my savings account has been cut, and I never saw a letter about it. I'm really unhappy.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can look into that. First, for security, can you confirm your full name and date of birth?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And the first line of your address, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. I can see the saver rate changed from 3.1% to 2.4% in August. We'll get the difference put back for you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Well, that's what I want, but I don't understand why I wasn't told.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. I'm logging this as a complaint. The reference is TB-684219.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. Can you check what happened with the letter?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'll review the notification records and the rate change. I'll do that and call you by 4pm this Friday, 30 October.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And what happens if it takes longer than that?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You'll get a full written response within 8 weeks of today. I'll send it to your address on file.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: So, I'm checking the letter records and rate change, then I'll call by Friday at 4pm; the full written response will be within 8 weeks. Does that make sense?
